art.hero: Three screens side by side, one for each module: a lattice of linked nodes, four faders and an eye in a lens. {opened} of {total} lessons opened, {p} percent complete overall.
art.presets: Four faders for the four prompt parameters: temperature, specificity, context depth and constraint strictness. Each knob stands at the mean of the presets you have applied, and a diamond above it fills in once its preset has been applied.
art.topology: The swarm as a lattice: its {layers} layers are columns of nodes, {nodes} in all, joined by lines. Nodes light up as you progress through the module.
art.wire: An eye inside a lens, with a bracket at each corner for the four vulnerabilities. {n} of {total} inspected.
